teaser: A room settles before anyone can say why. You are a life path 11 and an ISFJ, and that settling is the plainest fact of the pairing: a voltage built to illuminate, held inside hands that would rather fix the coffee urn than stand at the front of the room. The 11 wants to be a source; the ISFJ wants to be useful and unremarked. In the school pickup line, you notice the one child standing alone by the fence before the teacher does, and say nothing about having noticed. That noticing, kept quiet, is where this crossing lives.
excerpt: Three times a partner has said you could have just told me before you track down the exact sentence that stung.
